outlet.summary: ABC News in the United States, the network's national and world file is leading with Hiring blew past expectations in August, jobs report shows; LIVE: ABC News Live; 2 people rescued alive from tunnel after deadly Nepal-Tibet flash flood.

items.headline: Hiring blew past expectations in August, jobs report shows
items.detail: A jobs report on Friday provided a key gauge of the U.S. economy as shoppers weather elevated inflation and central bankers weigh a possible interest rate hike.

items.headline: LIVE: ABC News Live
items.detail: 24/7 coverage of breaking news and live events

items.headline: 2 people rescued alive from tunnel after deadly Nepal-Tibet flash flood
items.detail: Two people have been rescued from a hydropower tunnel at the Trishuli 3A construction site, Nepal's Army confirmed Friday after posting images of the scene on Facebook.

items.headline: Russia shifts tactics with round-the-clock attacks on Kyiv, disrupting daily life
items.detail: Russian drone and missile attacks in Kyiv have intensified, disrupting daily life with constant air-raid sirens

items.headline: WATCH: Top tennis stars battle for position at US Open
items.detail: ESPN’s Jeff Darlington breaks down Taylor Fritz’s strong start, Coco Gauff’s title hopes and Alexander Zverev’s run at the U.S. Open.
